mechanism_and_quality_notes: Thirteen exact readable labels. Context-layer removal and call consolidation are conceptually distinct from the lower quality-evidence rail. Cost/latency are exact publisher-reported figures with no misleading plotted scale. Quality caveat explicitly preserves medium-effort performance losses. Actual normalized and immutable committed readback pixels inspected. No people, brands, faux text, clipping or all-quality guarantee.
alt: A dual-rail editorial plate separates shared-context reuse, reduced context, fewer model calls and effort choices from a quality ledger, with publisher-reported cost and latency changes and an explicit medium-effort performance caveat.
